prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original wide scenic establishing illustration of EREBOR, the dwarven kingdom beneath the Lonely Mountain, for a One Ring culture setting background. Match the user's approved light-ivory pencil establishing series, especially Nogrod, Belegost and Khazad-dum. Camera pulled far back and elevated to a high three-quarter viewpoint from a rocky overlook, showing the colossal front gate of the Lonely Mountain and the dwarven entrance district integrated into its rocky slopes. A single immense mountain rises above the settlement, its distinctive solitary summit and long rugged shoulders dominating the distant skyline. An imposing recessed angular stone gateway is carved directly into the mountain face, framed by monumental squared pillars and restrained geometric dwarven stonework. Broad stone stairs, orderly terraces, sturdy covered galleries, workshops and a few small forge chimneys lead down toward a great paved approach road. A river emerges from a shadowed opening near the gate and descends through cut-stone channels and a small waterfall into the rocky valley; stout stone bridges connect the approach terraces. The city is chiefly WITHIN the mountain: show the grandeur of its gate, carved exterior galleries and working entrance precinct, not a vast freestanding human city spread across the mountainside or a cutaway of the underground interior. A few tiny distant supply carts may suggest scale but no foreground people, portraits or prominent figures. Foreground stone parapet, weathered steps, rugged rocks and sparse hardy trees guide the eye toward the gate. Clear coherent engineering and geography, dwarven craftsmanship grounded in massive squared geometry and chamfered arches, practical majesty. A thriving restored kingdom, no dragon, battle, destruction, treasure pile or monsters. STYLE: delicate traditional graphite and extremely muted brown-gray pencil drawing on very light near-white warm ivory drawing paper, subtle grain, fine expressive contours, restrained parallel hatching and crosshatching, airy shading and generous clean pale paper. Selectively describe near stonework and the gate; mountain ridges and distant valley become progressively lighter and simpler. Keep deep openings legible with layered pencil hatching, no broad solid-black voids. Match the approved series' pale paper tone, no orange, peach, yellow or tan wash. No colored paint, thick brushwork, watercolor wash, heavy black ink fills, photorealism, glossy digital rendering or 3D. Wide 16:9 full-bleed landscape, intended final export 2560x1440. No writing, readable runes, letters, labels, captions, map symbols, decorative border, frame, blank bottom strip, black bars, watermark or UI.
